rationale: Both react appropriately to TOUCH (t=8), OFFER_FOOD (t=32), and STARTLE (t=68). Creature A largely fixates on the ball early, then spends long spans with attention NONE (t=40–67, t=72–95), and does not reorient to CALL (t=20) or PRESENT_OBJECT:PLAY_BALL (t=44). Creature B responds to CALL (t=20) and PRESENT_OBJECT:PLAY_BALL (t=44), sustains coherent focus shifts, and shows spontaneous but sensible initiatives—anticipatory play-bow toward the ball before presentation (t=42), later exploring PERSON_BETA (t=54–67, t=94–95) and PLAY_CUBE (t=78–83). This yields higher coherence, adaptability, and apparent ongoing activity in B.
